description: This file defines a REST API endpoint class for managing employee immigration records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting immigration records associated with employees, utilizing service classes, validation rules, and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecordAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for CRUD operations on employee immigration records, including validation, service interactions, and OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getEmployeeImmigrationRecordService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmployeeImmigrationRecordService instance.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles retrieving a list of employee immigration records with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creating a new employee immigration record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a record.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for request bodies used in create and update operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee immigration record by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rules for retrieving one record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee immigration record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a record.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEmergencyImmigrations
methods.description: Creates or updates an EmployeeImmigrationRecord entity based on request parameters.
